facts.text: I have irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) symptoms.
I sometimes feel embarrassed discussing my IBS symptoms with others.
I find it difficult to explain my symptoms to my doctor sometimes.
I plan to keep a food and symptom journal to identify IBS triggers.
I plan to talk to my doctor about the best treatments for my IBS symptoms.
I plan to look into joining a support group or talking to a therapist to cope with emotional challenges from IBS.
